title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony

meta.Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! We're gonna have another great practice today♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's head to SEKAI already!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki, keep it down.
Everybody can hear you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And like I told you a second ago, there's still too many people around today so we'll have to wait a little more until we do head over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ever since we played that show, she's been as worked up as ever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We may've just been the opening act, but we finally got a chance to perform together. The crowd seemed really into it towards the end too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, it was sooo much fun!
I wanna do a show like that again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course, I'll be extra careful! But we're still gonna practice lots and lots♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We all decided to try and go pro, together. Since then, I've been having a lot more fun trying stuff out on my synthesizer instead of going out somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? I never thought I'd hear you say anything like that, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, right? Honestly, I thought she'd be the one asking for more time off for us to go out together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! No, I wouldn't!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, whenever I start feeling tired, my mind might wander towards doing something else...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But wanting to get better and go pro with all of you always comes out on top! I've just never been this enthusiastic before!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'd expect nothing less from you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we raise the bar a little for what we do during warm-ups?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You're gonna make things harder than before?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that a complaint? You said you want to get better as fast as possible, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry, Saki. I'll just be adjusting what we do based on the level you've risen to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Risen...? You're saying that I've actually gotten better? Yay! I love you so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
S-Saki... L-Let go...
I can't move...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! I'm really happy because you praised me, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Didn't you say during lunch that you'd like to talk to us about practice today, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sort of...
I guess now's a good time since we still can't head over yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tell us! Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's about what we'll be doing specifically moving forward as Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What we'll be doing...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I get it! It's like our first meeting to plan Operation Go Pro As Leo/need, right♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When did you come up with that name, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just now!
So about what we'll be doing...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right... This might take a while, so let's find an empty classroom where we can talk.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to start with what we'll need to do if we really are going to try and go pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: First, there are a few ways to become professional musicians...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! By auditioning and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like those shows where the winners get a big record deal♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, auditioning is one path that's open to us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Performing at live houses, getting better over time, and growing our fanbase is another option.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. An agency might scout us out after we've gained enough popularity.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. But it'll specifically be a record company instead of an agency.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Audition or earn fame through live house performances...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those are just the most standard routes, but there are other ways of going about this too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Lately, some artists have been finding the spotlight by making videos and posting them online.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's cool...
You know so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, regardless of which path we choose, we're still nowhere near playing like actual pros yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why we need to prioritize practicing, honing our skills, and getting experienced as much as we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Getting experience...
Does that mean we should perform in more shows too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, it does.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you all felt it during our last performance, but it doesn't matter how well you do during practice. Everything can still fall apart while we're on stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For the very first time, we had a crowd of people hear our music and saw how they reacted to our performance...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right. I couldn't sing at all at first because I was so scared. It was just such a big venue with so many people there...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I was so desperate to tell you how I felt that before I knew it, I was able to find my voice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too!
After I started focusing on wanting you to stay, Shiho, I was able to settle down and play normally!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
It felt like we all found the courage to rise up to the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was trying to say that we should perform while focusing on how our audience reacts, but... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure as we keep playing more and more shows, we'll keep on improving too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not just technically either. We'll get more used to playing in front of a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right... I'd like for us to get better and see more people coming to our performances.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like that too...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's kinda scary, but really fun at the same time... If it means getting better, then I wanna do that too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Then we can start focusing on performing in more shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
More shows...!
This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But how do we actually go about doing that? We've never even chosen where to perform before.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I asked the owner of the live house I work at and got the green light to perform in some events.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! You're awesome, Shiho♪
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have about a month to prepare for it, and I understand that it's going to be tight. Would you guys still be up for it...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A month... I'm okay with that.
What should we play?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How about the song we played when we opened for STANDOUT? I feel like we'll be able to play it much better now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought about that too. But they're going to give us about 15 minutes to play, so we'll probably need two more songs to fill out our slot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, three songs?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means we have to make a decision on our other two songs soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We do... Let's try going through the songs we've been practicing, some we might want to try and pick a couple out of that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. There are a few Miku songs that I've been wanting to try, so I'll make sure to look them up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But... It'd be nice to compose our own song and play it during a show too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our own song...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we'll have to start making our own songs too if we're gonna actually go pro. Just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember Shiho mentioning that we're gonna have to start making our own songs!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It'd be awesome if we could!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. Performing the songs you personally made must be so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right?! Ichi and I tried giving music to some lyrics we came up with... But if we're gonna actually play it during a show, I want to make something better!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe someday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're okay with just someday?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Putting together a song that we can play on stage is no simple task.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'd have to figure out how we're going to do that too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we have you, Shiho, so we'll be fine, right? You've been playing for bands forever too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No way. Arranging music a little is the most I can do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A long time ago, I tried making some songs myself, but it ended up being too much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I just wasn't able to turn what I was imagining into music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
If you had that much trouble, Shiho, then it must be incredibly difficult.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I do want to make songs with you guys since we've decided to go pro together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And we can try our hand at it little by little as we practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
While we practice...?
Oh, in that case...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if we each tried coming up with riffs and phrases starting next practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Our own riffs...?
Like short melodies or chord progressions?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Coming up with a whole song at once is too hard, but I know we can at least come up with snippets of one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That does sound interesting...
But can we get that to work?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've never done anything like that before, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it! Who knows? We might end up making something really good♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
Starting small sounds like a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can do that starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Let's give it our best shot!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki's just jumping for joy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, since there are fewer people around now, shall we head over to see Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, and I still want to talk about us as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go go go♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Our own shows, our own songs...
Hehe. This is sooo much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm gonna give it everything I've got!)
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all here.
Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Miku♪ Hi, Luka♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As peppy as ever, I see Saki.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were talking about what we should be doing if we're serious about going pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And we decided to play a show at the live house I work at as part of gaining more experience as a band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, a show?
That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
It's time to let the world know that Leo/need has finally arrived! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The world? That may be going a little too far, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the thought of setting out into the world could give us some extra motivation.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That also means we'll have to practice even more, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, we get it!
This is what we chose, so we'll just have to do our best♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why we're gonna need your help more than ever now, Miku. Please!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course I'll help.
We can practice as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. We'll be more than happy to keep supporting you girls however we can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly! Feel free to ask us about anything you like and we'll try to help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now then, how about we get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sounds good! Let's make today another...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh no! Everyone's already here?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Talk about a late entry! MEIKO, why didn't you tell me about what was going on?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. I'm sorry, Rin.
You were sound asleep and I didn't want to disturb you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?! Rin?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're the ones who created this SEKAI, right? It's nice to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm Kagamine Rin♪
I'll be a part of Miku-P's band from now on!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with all of you☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku-P...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Grumble*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What a cute nickname.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See? It's so much cuter and easier than just calling you by your regular name♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So if you don't mind, I'll be doing the same for all of you too♪ Sakki, Ichi, Hona and Shihoppy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, okay. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shihoppy...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
H-Hehe. Oh no...
She did it to your name too, Shiho... Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness. At least we have each other, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, but can you give me a different nickname?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
It's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, it's not.
I'm certain that Saki's gonna start copying you too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But your name sounds so much cuter that way...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with her♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Please, Rin, can't you think of something else...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You want me to change it that badly...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... What about Shih?
Yeah! How does that sound?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine... It's better than before...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thanks, Shih♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry, Miku-P. Looks like you're all alone now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Grumble*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Things are gonna be so much more fun now that Rin's here with us♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that reminds me. When you came here, MEIKO, you mentioned something about our feelings moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Does that mean you're here because of the same reason, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The reason I came to this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm not really sure...
When I realized it, I was here so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It may be because you all decided to “go pro” together and gave yourselves a new challenge to face, no...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think she's right!
I want to help you just like Miku-P and Luka do!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They even mentioned that they'll be performing in a show. You seem to have arrived just at the right time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? You're gonna put on a show?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we are. Well, we just decided to just a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
Have you already decided on what you're gonna play?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, not quite...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We don't know what we'll be playing yet, but we at least know what we want to do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our goal is to play music that can move the hearts of those who come and listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so nice! Pure friendship! I can tell how committed you are to each other!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't forget to ask if you ever need any help too! I'll do whatever I can to make sure your show's as happy and fun as it can be♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then let's start practicing for it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make today another good one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... I'm beat...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we have to be able to do better than this if we're serious about becoming professionals.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How did my singing sound just now, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You sounded good.
And you'll sound even better once you're pitch-perfect throughout the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
Got it. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, can you do me next?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have such a steady beat now, Honami, but your rimshots during the second verse were a little weak. Your rhythm is fine, so just hit it like you mean it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's exactly the part I was worried about. Thank you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your fingers aren't keeping up during some key changes and you have a tendency to go a little too fast, so you might want to work on your finger rolls.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But I'm so bad at that part...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I practiced so much and still haven't gotten it down...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're playing the part before your synth solo much better now, so try to keep in mind what you've been doing there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay! Let me write that down...
The part before my solo... Got it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you've all improved so much compared to before. Let's keep this up and get ready for our show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (*Sigh*... I still have so much work to do...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wasn't able to play the piano for so long since I was in the hospital. Am I holding everyone back...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time for any of that. I need to keep practicing...!)
A few days later
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's end things here for today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great job!
And it's sooo hot!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You were really giving it 110% today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought so too. You made it so much fun to drum to your beat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because it's so much to play like this with everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But still, I fell way behind everyone today in some spots...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That means I need to practice even more...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh, Saki...
After practice the other day, did you stay behind to keep working on your part?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, I did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even when we don't have practice together, I still try to play my synth as much as I can. Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You just seemed a little tired is all. Are you sure you're feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm being careful like I said♪
I'm even taking fewer shifts at work because we're practicing so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's good but try not to overdo it, okay? You're free to say so if things aren't alright.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know♪ Thanks, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're also sharing the phrases we came up with after this, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. I came up with some ideas, but how about the rest of you...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have a couple. It was more of a challenge than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh! Oh! Me next!
I came up with three!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's amazing...!
I could only come up with one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's your first time, so one is more than plenty.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It'd be nice to have Miku and the others hear what we came up with too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure... But I am a little worried about having everyone hear something I made myself, so I'm sort of glad we're doing this today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, and we can go in the same order as we did just now. I'll start.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That should be everything...
So what did everyone think...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I really liked Ichi's second one!
The part when it switches to a minor key sounded so cool!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. I thought it was cool too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, I wasn't really sure what to do or where to go with that part...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe you tried to include too many things like you weren't sure which you should say yes or no to...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you might be right.
I listened to quite a few songs as references and did get overloaded a little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Overall, I thought it sounded pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay... But I feel like if we're going to be playing it together, there are better options out there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Should we try a different one then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A different one...?
I had Shiho's first one as another candidate.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: About that... It's based on a song by an artist I've been heavily influenced by...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's sort of in the same boat as Ichika's. I'm not sure it's the best option for Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It just seems even more difficult after actually putting pen to paper and listening to everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It sounded alright when I was putting it together, but it's not what I thought it was anymore.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree... It's hard to say what's good or bad, so it doesn't feel right to make a judgment even after listening to everything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ugh... This is starting to make my head hurt...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It might be because we don't know exactly what kind of music we want to play yet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The kind of music we want to play...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I never knew it was so hard to create a song from scratch...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
My thoughts exactly.
Will we ever be able to...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think we will...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As long as we're together, I'm sure we can! They say everybody goes through this in the beginning, right?
